page.overview:
Who is Dark Matter Empire?

The Dark Matter Empire (ダークマター Dākumatā Teikoku) are an outer-space alliance introduced in the third season of the Yu-Gi-Oh! GO RUSH!! anime. They serve as the main antagonists for the series' ninth and tenth arcs and are largely made up of the Darkmen.

Despite their name, the Dark Matter Empire are unknown to the Velgearians and have had little contact with beings from the light side. It is eventually revealed this is due to them being a new organization, having only been formed one month prior to their first encounters with the crew of Varivelgear. Even so, the Dark Matter Empire has full knowledge of Rush Dueling and Duel Disks.

The Dark Matter Empire were formed one month prior to their encounters with other beings. When Yudias and the other used the Hyper Matter Blender to make Varivelgear CPT, Fukamura added Dark Power to the blender so she can be loyal to the Dark Matter Empire.

While travelling through space, Sabyuas encountered Varivelgear. Following it crash-landing on the Gradonium Mining Planet, Sabyuas encountered the Varivelgear CPT and infiltrated the ship, emerging from his hiding place to prevent Yuhi Ohdo from going to the bathroom simply to derive satisfaction from his minor suffering and challenging Yuhi to a Rush Duel over the matter. Yuhi defeated Sabyuas, who instructed CPT to repair the bathroom and informed Yudias Velgear of the existence of the Dark Matter Empire before departing.
